requirements.semantic_classification: 56-bit generation/epoch stable-data release token; normal use follows a two-stage release-toggle synchronizer, while reset accounting follows a two-stage transport-request synchronizer and captured release-phase retirement

new_required_signoff.semantic_classification: 56-bit generation/epoch stable-data release token; normal use follows a two-stage release-toggle synchronizer, while reset accounting follows a two-stage transport-request synchronizer and captured release-phase retirement

semantic_families.name: RELEASE_SLOT0_NORMAL_STATE_TRANSITION
semantic_families.semantic_role: Matching slot-0 token authorizes DMA_OWNED to RELEASABLE

semantic_families.name: RELEASE_SLOT0_MISMATCH_CONTAINMENT
semantic_families.semantic_role: Mismatched generation epoch reset-epoch or ownership state fails closed

semantic_families.name: RELEASE_SLOT0_RESET_OVERLAP_ACCOUNTING
semantic_families.semantic_role: Synchronized transport request uses same-episode release token for reset abandoned-record accounting before captured-phase retirement

absolute_settling.requirement: Every existing payload-dependent path must reach its same-edge semantic endpoint before the relevant synchronized qualifier can authorize evaluation.

stable_data_lifetime.requirement: Generation and epoch must not change while the event crosses and is consumed.

destination_use_ordering.requirement: Token fields and release toggle launch together; a same-edge reset captures that release phase and launches its transport request. Normal use follows the release toggle, while reset accounting follows the transport request.

semantic_families.name: RELEASE_SLOT1_MISMATCH_CONTAINMENT

semantic_families.name: RELEASE_SLOT1_RESET_OVERLAP_ACCOUNTING
semantic_families.semantic_role: Captured release phase participates in reset-abandoned accounting before retirement
